findings.title: Small-action button no longer right-aligned after flexbox conversion
findings.body: The `.small-action` container is now a flex container via `@include flexbox()`, but the existing `button` rule still has `float: right` (line 309). Floats are ignored on flex items, and there is no `margin-left: auto` on the button or `flex-grow` on `.small-action-desc` to push it to the right edge. As a result, the button is laid out immediately after `.small-action-desc` rather than at the right edge of the row.

findings.title: align-items mixin omits -moz-box-align for old Firefox fallback
findings.body: `flexbox()` and `inline-flex()` emit `display: -moz-box` / `-moz-inline-box`, but `align-items()` does not emit the corresponding old Firefox property `-moz-box-align`. In a Firefox build that relies on the `-moz-box` fallback, the `center` or `baseline` alignment will be ignored. Add `-moz-box-align: $alignment;` or remove the `-moz-box` display fallbacks.
